exceptions.justification: Dev-only: reachable only via @lhci/cli > lighthouse > puppeteer-core > chromium-bidi, which declares zod ^3.24.1. No patched 3.x release exists — the fix (>=4.6.6) violates the consumer's peer range, and forcing it would break the lighthouse dev runner, not a shipped surface. Production bundles never include zod. Review when a patched 3.x line ships or @lhci/cli upgrades puppeteer-core.
